questions.question: In July 2025, which global insurance giant entered into a binding agreement with Jio Financial Services to form a 50:50 reinsurance joint venture?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Allianz Group**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **July 2025**, **Jio Financial Services (JFS)**, the financial services arm of **Reliance Industries Limited**, announced the signing of a binding agreement with the **Allianz Group**.
 
• The agreement aims to establish a **50:50 joint venture** to enter the **reinsurance** sector in **India**, marking a significant entry for **Jio** into the complex risk-management market.
 
• This partnership signifies **Allianz's** strategic pivot in the Indian market as it seeks to leverage **Jio’s** extensive **digital infrastructure** and customer base to offer reinsurance solutions.
 
• The **reinsurance joint venture** is expected to provide specialized capacity for insurance companies to offload risks, thereby strengthening the overall insurance ecosystem in the country.
 
• The commencement of operations for this venture is subject to regulatory approvals from the **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)** and other relevant authorities. ***Hence, the correct answer is Allianz Group.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Allianz Group:**
 
 
• It is a **German** multinational financial services company headquartered in **Munich**.
 
• Founded in **1890**, it is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers, operating in over **70 countries**.
 
• Before this **2025** agreement, **Allianz** had a long-standing partnership with the **Bajaj Group** in India, holding significant stakes in **Bajaj Allianz General Insurance** and **Bajaj Allianz Life Insurance** since **2001**.
 
 
 
• **Jio Financial Services (JFS):**
 
 
• Originally a part of **Reliance Industries**, it was demerged and listed as an independent entity in **2023**.
 
• Under the leadership of Chairman **K.V. Kamath**, **JFS** has rapidly expanded into lending, digital payments, and asset management, including a notable **joint venture** with **BlackRock**.
 
• The company aims to democratize financial services in **India** through a **digital-first** approach.
 
 
 
• **Reinsurance Sector:**
 
 
• **Reinsurance** is essentially "insurance for insurance companies," where a reinsurer takes on a portion of the risk from an insurer in exchange for a premium.
 
• In **India**, the market is historically dominated by the state-owned **GIC Re (General Insurance Corporation of India)**, which was established in **1972**.
 
• The **Indian** market has recently opened up to several global reinsurers like **Munich Re**, **Swiss Re**, and **Hannover Re**, which operate through branch offices.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Regulatory Landscape:** The **IRDAI** is the statutory body responsible for regulating the insurance and reinsurance industries in **India**. It was constituted under the **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999**.
 
• **FDI in Insurance:** The Government of India increased the **Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)** limit in the insurance sector from **49 percent** to **74 percent** in **2021** to attract more global capital and expertise.
 
• **Market Potential:** With **India** having one of the lowest insurance penetration rates globally, the **reinsurance** sector is critical for supporting large-scale infrastructure projects and managing **catastrophic risks**.

questions.question: In May 2025, which state / union territory government mandated rooftop sprinkler systems on high-rise buildings?
questions.solution:
p data-end="57" data-start="0">The correct answer is __**Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Government of NCT of Delhi** issued a significant mandate in **May 2025** requiring the installation of **rooftop sprinkler systems** on all **high-rise buildings**.
 
• The primary objective of this directive is to mitigate the intense **Urban Heat Island (UHI)** effect that significantly raises temperatures in the capital during peak **summer months**.
 
• This decision was spearheaded by the **Delhi Disaster Management Authority (DDMA)** as part of its updated **Heat Action Plan** to enhance **urban resilience** against record-breaking temperatures.
 
• The mandate applies to both **residential and commercial** high-rise structures, requiring them to utilize automated or manual sprinkler systems to cool building surfaces.
 
• By cooling the exterior of the buildings, the initiative aims to reduce the **indoor cooling load**, thereby decreasing the overall **electricity demand** for air conditioning across the city.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Urban Heat Island (UHI) Effect**:
 
 
• This phenomenon occurs when urban areas experience much higher temperatures than surrounding rural areas due to **concrete surfaces**, **dense infrastructure**, and high **anthropogenic heat**.
 
• In **Delhi**, the UHI effect has been known to cause temperature differences of **5 to 10 degrees Celsius** compared to neighboring forested or rural regions.
 
 
 
• **Delhi Disaster Management Authority (DDMA)**:
 
 
• Established under the **Disaster Management Act, 2005**, the DDMA is the apex body for disaster planning and response in the **National Capital Territory**.
 
• The authority is chaired by the **Lieutenant Governor of Delhi**, with the **Chief Minister** serving as the Vice-Chairperson.
 
 
 
• **Heat Action Plan (HAP)**:
 
 
• The HAP is a comprehensive framework that includes **early warning systems**, public awareness campaigns, and long-term **mitigation strategies** like **cool roofs** and **afforestation**.
 
• The 2025 update specifically introduced **active cooling technology**, such as the rooftop sprinkler mandate, to deal with **extreme heatwaves**.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Urban Development**:
 
 
• Mandating sprinklers is aligned with **green building norms**, encouraging developers to integrate **sustainable water management** into urban architecture.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Water Sourcing**: To ensure the sustainability of the project, the mandate suggests that building owners should use **treated wastewater** from **Sewage Treatment Plants (STPs)** or **rainwater harvesting** systems instead of fresh potable water.
 
• **Building Height Classification**: For the purpose of this mandate, buildings exceeding **15 meters** in height are generally classified as **high-rise** under the **Unified Building Bye-Laws for Delhi**.
 
• **Compliance and Monitoring**: The **Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD)** and the **Delhi Fire Services** are tasked with inspecting buildings to ensure the sprinkler systems are installed and functional.
 
• **Impact on Power Grid**: By lowering the **surface temperature** of buildings, the government expects a reduction in the **peak power load** during the day, preventing **transformer failures** and **power outages** during heatwaves.
</ul

questions.question: In September 2025, what move did Karnataka take to address unemployment by building future-ready workforce capacity?

options.text: International scholarship scheme for student internships abroad
Reservation policy mandating jobs only for Karnataka residents
State Skill Development Policy using digital and inclusive training tools
Sectoral incentive plan focusing mainly on agriculture and handicrafts

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**State Skill Development Policy using digital and inclusive training tools**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **September 2025**, the Government of **Karnataka** introduced a comprehensive **State Skill Development Policy** specifically designed to tackle **unemployment** by aligning the local labor force with evolving global industry standards.
 
• The primary objective of this move is to build a **future-ready workforce capacity** through the integration of **digital training tools**, such as **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** and **Augmented Reality (AR)**, into the vocational education system.
 
• The policy prioritizes **inclusive training**, ensuring that socio-economically backward regions and **rural youth** receive the same quality of technical education as those in urban centers like **Bengaluru**.
 
• By focusing on **digital literacy** and **high-tech skills**, the policy aims to transition the state from traditional labor-intensive roles to **knowledge-based employment** opportunities.
 
• This initiative is part of a larger strategy to maintain **Karnataka's** position as a leading destination for **Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)** and industrial innovation in **India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood Department (SDEL):**
 
 
• This department acts as the **nodal agency** in **Karnataka** for implementing various employment-linked schemes, including the **Chief Minister’s Kaushalya Karnataka Yojane (CMKKY)**.
 
• The department oversees the **Karnataka Skill Development Corporation (KSDC)**, which facilitates **Public-Private Partnerships (PPP)** to enhance training infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Industry 4.0 Integration:**
 
 
• The 2025 policy is heavily influenced by the principles of **Industry 4.0**, which emphasizes **automation**, **data exchange**, and **smart manufacturing**.
 
• Training modules now include **cybersecurity**, **Internet of Things (IoT)**, and **Cloud Computing** to cater to the demands of the **IT** and **Aerospace** sectors.
 
 
 
• **Incentives and Subsidies:**
 
 
• To encourage participation, the state provides **stipends** to trainees and **tax incentives** to companies that establish **Centers of Excellence (CoE)** within the state.
 
• Special focus is given to **women entrepreneurs** and **startups** through dedicated **incubation centers** funded under the state's **startup policy**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Target Population:** The policy aims to certify over **1.5 million youth** over a period of **three years**, targeting an **age group** of **18 to 35 years**.
 
• **Geographical Outreach:** While **Bengaluru** remains a tech hub, this policy mandates the setting up of **Skill Hubs** in **Tier-2** and **Tier-3 cities** like **Mysuru**, **Hubballi**, and **Kalaburagi**.
 
• **Digital Skill Passport:** A unique feature introduced in **2025** is the **Digital Skill Passport**, a blockchain-based credential that allows employers to verify a candidate's **certifications** and **work experience** instantly.
 
• **Global Collaboration:** **Karnataka** has signed various **Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs)** with international organizations and **multinational corporations (MNCs)** to provide global certification standards to local students.

questions.question: In October 2024, which state government launched India’s first integrated state-level Cyber Command and Control Centre to serve as a comprehensive hub for handling grievances through multiple channels, including a helpline, web portal and mobile app?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **October 2024**, the state government of **Maharashtra** launched India’s **first integrated state-level Cyber Command and Control Centre (C4)**.
 
• The facility was officially inaugurated by the Deputy Chief Minister of **Maharashtra**, **Shri Devendra Fadnavis**, at **Mahape in Navi Mumbai** on **October 3, 2024**.
 
• This center serves as a comprehensive hub for citizens to report cybercrimes through multiple platforms, including a dedicated **helpline number 14407**, a specialized **web portal**, and a **mobile application**.
 
• The primary objective of this project is to provide a swift response to cyber-related grievances and to tackle the rising instances of **financial frauds** and **digital threats** across the state.
 
• The **Cyber Command and Control Centre** is equipped with **advanced technology**, including **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** and **Machine Learning (ML)**, to monitor and mitigate cyber-attacks in real-time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra Cyber Security Project**:
 
 
• The **Cyber Command and Control Centre** is a major component of the larger **Maharashtra Cyber Security Project**, which has an estimated budget of approximately **Rs. 837 crore**.
 
• This initiative aims to modernize the state's **cyber defense infrastructure**, making it one of the most technologically advanced security hubs in the **country**.
 
 
 
• **Integrated Operations**:
 
 
• The center brings together **50 representatives from various banks** and financial institutions to work alongside **police officials** and **technical experts**.
 
• This integration ensures that the "**Golden Hour**" (the critical period immediately after a crime) is utilized effectively to **freeze fraudulent transactions** and recover stolen money for victims.
 
 
 
• **Technical Capabilities**:
 
 
• The facility includes specialized units for **digital forensics**, **malware analysis**, and **threat intelligence** to stay ahead of evolving **cyber-criminal tactics**.
 
• It will provide support to all **district-level cyber police stations** in **Maharashtra**, acting as a central nervous system for **cyber law enforcement**.
 
 
 
• **Global Context**:
 
 
• The establishment of this center places **Maharashtra** at the forefront of **digital safety** in India, aligning with global standards for **cybersecurity governance**.
 
• By centralizing grievance handling, the government aims to increase the **conviction rate** in cyber-related cases, which has historically been a challenge due to the borderless nature of such crimes.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **helpline 14407** will be operational **24/7** to assist victims of **online scams** and **identity theft**.
 
• The project involves collaboration with private sector **security firms** and **global technology partners** to ensure the latest software and **encryption standards** are used.
 
• The **Navi Mumbai** facility is expected to serve as a **model project** that other states in **India** might replicate to strengthen their own **digital security frameworks**.

questions.question: In which Union Budget was the Prime Minister Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana announced by the Government of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2025-2026**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Prime Minister Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana (PM-DDKY)** was announced by the Union Finance Minister **Nirmala Sitharaman** during the presentation of the **Union Budget 2025-26** on **February 1, 2025**.
 
• This initiative is a comprehensive scheme aimed at achieving **Atmanirbharta (self-reliance)** in the production of **pulses** and **oilseeds**, which are critical components of India's food basket.
 
• The scheme focuses on enhancing the entire value chain, including **production**, **storage**, **processing**, and **marketing** of agricultural produce to ensure higher returns for farmers.
 
• A primary objective of **PM-DDKY** is to reduce India's heavy dependency on imports for **edible oils**, thereby saving foreign exchange and strengthening national **food security**.
 
• The budget allocation for this scheme is designed to provide farmers with access to **high-yielding variety (HYV) seeds**, modern **farming technology**, and robust **market linkages**. ***Hence, the correct answer is 2025-2026.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Focus on Oilseeds:**
 
 
• The **Union Budget 2025-26** places significant emphasis on **mustard**, **groundnut**, **sesame**, **soybean**, and **sunflower** to boost domestic edible oil production.
 
• This aligns with the **Atmanirbhar Oilseeds Abhiyan**, which seeks to bridge the gap between demand and domestic supply.
 
 
 
• **Agricultural Infrastructure:**
 
 
• The government aims to strengthen **Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI)** in agriculture to facilitate **crop estimation** and **digital credit** for farmers.
 
• **PM-DDKY** is expected to integrate with existing schemes like **PM-KISAN** to provide a holistic support system for small and marginal farmers.
 
 
 
• **Budgetary Strategy for Farmers:**
 
 
• The **Union Budget 2025-26** increased the **Agricultural Credit Target** to a record high to ensure adequate **liquidity** for rural entrepreneurs and farmers.
 
• Special provisions have been made for **Climate-Resilient Agriculture**, developing **109 new varieties** of 32 field and horticultural crops for cultivation by farmers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Economic Impact:** By promoting the **Prime Minister Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana**, the government intends to stabilize **retail inflation** related to food items, particularly **pulses**.
 
• **Natural Farming:** As part of the broader agricultural vision in the **2025-2026** budget, **one crore farmers** across the country are to be initiated into **Natural Farming** over the next two years, supported by **certification** and branding.
 
• **Procurement and MSP:** The scheme works in tandem with the government's commitment to **Minimum Support Price (MSP)** operations, ensuring that the increased production of **Dhan (Grains)** and **Dhaanya (Wealth/Crops)** translates into financial security for the agricultural community.
</ul

questions.question: Which swimmer set multiple WRs in the 400 m freestyle, 200 m IM, and 400 m IM during the World Short Course Swimming Championships in Budapest, Hungary, 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Summer McIntosh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Summer McIntosh**, a teenage swimming sensation from **Canada**, delivered one of the most dominant performances in aquatic history at the **World Short Course Swimming Championships (25m)** held in **Budapest, Hungary**, in **December 2024**.
 
• During the championships, she set a new **World Record** in the **400m Freestyle** with a staggering time of **3:51.30**, showcasing her exceptional endurance and speed in the 25-meter pool.
 
• She continued her record-breaking spree in the **200m Individual Medley (IM)**, clocking a time of **2:01.86** to shatter the previous global mark. This event requires mastery over all four swimming strokes: **butterfly**, **backstroke**, **breaststroke**, and **freestyle**.
 
• In the **400m Individual Medley (IM)**, she established another **World Record** with a time of **4:18.43**, further cementing her status as the world's premier medley swimmer.
 
• Her performance in **Budapest** marked the first time a swimmer had broken three individual world records at a single **World Short Course Championship** in the modern era.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Athlete Profile:** **Summer McIntosh** was born in **August 2006** in **Toronto**. She is the daughter of **Jill Horstead**, who competed in swimming for Canada at the **1984 Los Angeles Olympics**.
 
• **Olympic Success:** Prior to her success in **Budapest**, McIntosh was the standout performer at the **Paris 2024 Olympic Games**, where she won **three gold medals** (400m IM, 200m Butterfly, and 200m IM) and one silver medal.
 
• **Short Course vs. Long Course:** **Short Course** swimming takes place in a **25-meter pool**, which emphasizes the "turns" and "underwater phases" more than **Long Course** swimming, which is conducted in a **50-meter Olympic-sized pool**.
 
• **World Aquatics:** The event in **Budapest** was organized by **World Aquatics** (formerly known as **FINA**), the international federation recognized by the **International Olympic Committee (IOC)** for administering international competitions in water sports.
 
• **Comparison:** While **Katie Ledecky** (USA) and **Ariarne Titmus** (Australia) are legendary figures in **freestyle** swimming, **Summer McIntosh** has distinguished herself by combining elite freestyle speed with world-class proficiency in the **butterfly** and **medley** disciplines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Medley Order:** In **Individual Medley (IM)** events, the strokes must be swum in the order of **Butterfly**, **Backstroke**, **Breaststroke**, and **Freestyle**. **Summer McIntosh** is currently considered the most versatile swimmer globally due to her strength in all four segments.
 
• **Historical Context:** The **2024 World Short Course Championships** saw **Budapest** hosting the event at the **Duna Arena**, a venue famous for hosting multiple **World Aquatics Championships** (2017 and 2022).
 
• **Records:** **World Records** in short course are often faster than long course times because swimmers benefit from more frequent wall push-offs and streamlined glides during turns.
</ul

questions.question: Which of the following international organizations was founded in 1945 to promote peace, security and cooperation among countries worldwide?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**United Nations (UN)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **United Nations (UN)** is an international organization founded on **October 24, 1945**, following the end of **World War II**.
 
• Its primary mission is to maintain **international peace and security**, develop friendly relations among nations, and promote **social progress**, better living standards, and **human rights**.
 
• The organization was established by **51 founding member states** who signed the **UN Charter** in **San Francisco, USA**. As of today, it has grown to include **193 member states**.
 
• The **UN** succeeded the **League of Nations**, which had failed to prevent the second global conflict. It operates through six principal organs: the **General Assembly**, the **Security Council**, the **Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC)**, the **Trusteeship Council**, the **International Court of Justice (ICJ)**, and the **UN Secretariat**.
 
• The **Secretary-General** serves as the chief administrative officer of the organization, representing the **United Nations** on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO):**
 
 
• **NATO** was established on **April 4, 1949**, with the signing of the **North Atlantic Treaty** (Washington Treaty).
 
• It is a **political and military alliance** of **32 member countries** from **Europe** and **North America**, committed to the principle of **collective defense**.
 
• Its headquarters is located in **Brussels, Belgium**.
 
 
 
• **World Trade Organization (WTO):**
 
 
• The **WTO** is the only global international organization dealing with the **rules of trade** between nations.
 
• It officially commenced operations on **January 1, 1995**, under the **Marrakesh Agreement**, replacing the **General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT)** which had been in place since **1948**.
 
• It is headquartered in **Geneva, Switzerland**, and currently consists of **164 member states**.
 
 
 
• **International Monetary Fund (IMF):**
 
 
• The **IMF** was conceived at a **UN conference** in **Bretton Woods, New Hampshire, USA**, in **July 1944** and began formal existence in **December 1945**.
 
• Its main functions are to foster **global monetary cooperation**, secure **financial stability**, facilitate **international trade**, and promote sustainable **economic growth**.
 
• The organization is based in **Washington, D.C.**, and provides **loans** and **technical assistance** to its **190 member countries**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **UN Security Council** is responsible for maintaining **international peace** and consists of **15 members**: **5 permanent members** (China, France, Russian Federation, the United Kingdom, and the United States) and **10 non-permanent members** elected for two-year terms.
 
• The **UN Day** is celebrated every year on **October 24** to mark the anniversary of the entry into force of the **UN Charter** in **1945**.
 
• The **United Nations** headquarters is situated on **international territory** in **New York City**, although the land was donated by the **Rockefeller family**.
</ul

questions.question: Which of the following national parks was highlighted in 2025 as a leading grassland bird habitat after its inaugural survey recorded 43 grassland bird species (including Finn’s Weaver and Bengal Florican)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kaziranga National Park**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kaziranga National Park and Tiger Reserve (KNPTR)**, located in the state of **Assam**, conducted its **inaugural grassland bird survey** in early **2025**.
 
• The survey was a milestone in avian conservation, recording a total of **43 grassland bird species** within the park's unique ecosystem.
 
• The exercise highlighted the park as a **leading grassland bird habitat**, specifically identifying rare and threatened species such as the **Finn’s Weaver** and the **Bengal Florican**.
 
• This census was part of a broader effort to monitor biodiversity beyond the park's famous megafauna, using the **point count method** across multiple ranges including **Kohora**, **Bagori**, and **Agoratoli**.
 
• The documentation of **Finn's Weaver** is particularly significant as it is one of the rarest weaver birds in the world, with very few viable populations remaining in the **Terai** and **Brahmaputra** floodplains.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kaziranga National Park**:
 
 
• It was declared a **World Heritage Site** by **UNESCO** in **1985**.
 
• It is home to two-thirds of the world's population of the **Great One-horned Rhinoceros**.
 
• The park is situated on the banks of the **Brahmaputra River** and is characterized by tall **elephant grass**, marshland, and dense tropical moist broadleaf forests.
 
 
 
• **Bengal Florican (Houbaropsis bengalensis)**:
 
 
• It is listed as **Critically Endangered** on the **IUCN Red List**.
 
• This bird is a **grassland specialist** and serves as an indicator species for the health of the **alluvial grassland** ecosystem.
 
 
 
• **Other National Parks in Options**:
 
 
• **Dudhwa National Park**: Located in **Lakhimpur Kheri, Uttar Pradesh**, it is part of the **Terai Arc Landscape** and also hosts the **Bengal Florican**, but it was not the site of the specific **43-species** survey mentioned for **2025**.
 
• **Desert National Park**: Situated in **Rajasthan** near **Jaisalmer**, it is the primary habitat for the **Great Indian Bustard** (another grassland bird) rather than the **Bengal Florican**.
 
• **Keoladeo National Park**: Located in **Bharatpur, Rajasthan**, it is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** famous primarily as a **wetland** habitat for migratory waterfowl like the **Siberian Crane** (formerly).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Conservation Status**: The **Finn's Weaver** is classified as **Endangered**, and its discovery in high numbers during the **2025 survey** reinforces the importance of **Kaziranga** as a crucial conservation hub.
 
• **Survey Methodology**: The **2025 survey** involved over **100 volunteers** and forest officials, covering approximately **20-25 square kilometers** of intense grassland patches to ensure accurate data collection.
 
• **Habitat Management**: The success of these bird populations is often attributed to the controlled **grassland burning** and management practices carried out by the **Assam Forest Department** to maintain the **short-grass** and **tall-grass** mosaic.
 
• **BirdLife International**: **Kaziranga** has also been identified as an **Important Bird Area (IBA)** by **BirdLife International** due to its role in the conservation of globally threatened avian species.

questions.question: The new logo unveiled by the Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI) conveys which core theme that highlights the importance of official statistics in national progress?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Data for Development**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI)** recently unveiled its new logo, which symbolizes the modernization of the national statistical system and its alignment with **India’s** journey toward becoming a developed nation.
 
• The core theme conveyed by the new logo is **“Data for Development,”** emphasizing that accurate and timely **official statistics** are the backbone of **national progress** and **socio-economic** planning.
 
• The logo is designed to represent the integration of data and technology, reflecting the ministry’s mission to provide **reliable, timely, and credible data** for **evidence-based policy-making**.
 
• This rebranding highlights the importance of the **National Statistical Office (NSO)** in capturing the diverse realities of the country through numbers, which eventually drive **sustainable development** and **equitable growth**.
 
• The unveiling of the logo coincided with the ministry’s efforts to enhance **data transparency** and **accessibility**, ensuring that statistical insights are available to citizens, researchers, and policymakers alike to foster an informed society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI):**
 
 
• **MoSPI** was created as an independent ministry in **1999** following the merger of the **Department of Statistics** and the **Department of Programme Implementation**.
 
• It serves as the nodal agency for the planned development of the statistical system in **India**, ensuring the quality of statistics released and maintaining **international standards**.
 
• The ministry is responsible for key economic indicators such as the **Consumer Price Index (CPI)**, the **Index of Industrial Production (IIP)**, and **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)** estimates.
 
 
 
• **National Statistics Day:**
 
 
• **India** celebrates **National Statistics Day** every year on **29th June**.
 
• This date marks the birth anniversary of **Prof. Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis**, who is widely regarded as the **Father of Indian Statistics** and the founder of the **Indian Statistical Institute (ISI)**.
 
• The day is dedicated to sensitizing the public, especially the younger generation, about the role and importance of **statistics** in **socio-economic planning** and policy formulation.
 
 
 
• **Structural Components:**
 
 
• The ministry consists of two main wings: the **National Statistical Office (NSO)** and the **Programme Implementation Wing**.
 
• The **NSO** is further divided into the **Central Statistics Office (CSO)** and the **National Sample Survey Office (NSSO)**, which conduct large-scale surveys on **employment**, **expenditure**, and **industrial activities**.
 
• The **Programme Implementation Wing** monitors the performance of **infrastructure sectors** and the implementation of the **Members of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme (MPLADS)**.
 
 
 
• **Digital Initiatives:**
 
 
• To support the **“Data for Development”** theme, the ministry launched the **e-Sankhyiki Portal** in **2024**.
 
• This portal acts as a centralized repository for **national indicators** and **official statistics**, significantly improving the **ease of doing research** and enhancing **public service delivery** through data.
 
• The integration of **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** and **Machine Learning (ML)** in data processing is a key feature of the ministry's vision for a **Digital India**.

questions.question: From 1 August 2025, what is the new minimum average monthly balance (MAB) ICICI Bank requires for savings accounts in metro and urban areas for new customers?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**₹15,000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **ICICI Bank**, one of India's leading private sector lenders, has announced a revision in the **minimum average monthly balance (MAB)** requirements for its savings account holders.
 
• From **1 August 2025**, the new **MAB** requirement for savings accounts in **metro** and **urban areas** will be **₹15,000**.
 
• Prior to this revision, the required **minimum average monthly balance** for these geographical locations was typically set at **₹10,000**.
 
• This specific update is applicable to **new customers** who initiate their banking relationship with **ICICI Bank** on or after the **1st of August, 2025**.
 
• The bank's decision to increase the **MAB** is part of its periodic review of **service charges** and **operational costs** associated with maintaining liquid savings accounts in high-cost areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Geographical Classification:** Banks in **India** categorize branches into **Metro**, **Urban**, **Semi-Urban**, and **Rural** tiers to determine different **MAB** thresholds based on the local economic landscape.
 
• **MAB Calculation:** The **Minimum Average Monthly Balance** is calculated by adding the **daily closing balances** of the account for every day in a calendar month and dividing the total by the **number of days** in that month.
 
• **Non-Maintenance Charges:** If a customer fails to maintain the stipulated **₹15,000** balance, **ICICI Bank** levies a **non-maintenance charge**. This penalty is usually a percentage of the **shortfall** between the actual balance and the required **MAB**.
 
• **Exempted Accounts:** Certain types of accounts, such as **Salary Accounts**, **Basic Savings Bank Deposit Accounts (BSBDA)**, and **Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)** accounts, are typically **zero-balance accounts** and do not require an **MAB**.
 
• **Industry Trends:** Other major private banks like **HDFC Bank** and **Axis Bank** also periodically adjust their **minimum balance** requirements to align with **inflation** and the rising costs of **digital banking infrastructure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Implementation Date:** The change is strictly scheduled for **1 August 2025**, and customers opening accounts before this **date** may be governed by the previous **schedule of charges** until further notice.
 
• **Customer Communication:** Regulators like the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** mandate that banks must inform customers of any change in **service charges** or **balance requirements** at least **30 days** in advance.
 
• **Tiered Services:** Higher **MAB** requirements often come with added benefits such as a higher number of **free ATM transactions**, discounted **locker rentals**, and personalized **wealth management** services.

questions.question: Which cricketer earned the prestigious title of ICC Men’s Test Cricketer of the Year for 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jasprit Bumrah**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jasprit Bumrah**, the premier Indian fast bowler, has been recognized for his extraordinary dominance in the longest format of the game, particularly throughout the **2023-2024** cycle.
 
• In **February 2024**, **Jasprit Bumrah** created history by becoming the **first Indian pacer** to reach the **Number 1** spot in the **ICC Men’s Test Player Rankings**.
 
• His performance in the **Test series** against **England** in **2024** was a major factor in this recognition, where he picked up **19 wickets** in just three matches, including a match-winning **9-wicket haul** in the **Vizag Test**.
 
• Bumrah's ability to perform across different conditions, from the pace-friendly tracks of **South Africa** to the spinning tracks of **India**, solidified his reputation as the world's most versatile red-ball bowler.
 
• The **ICC Awards** are presented annually to honor the best performers in international cricket; for the **2024** evaluation period, Bumrah's impact on **Test Cricket** was deemed the most significant among global nominees.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **International Cricket Council (ICC):**
 
 
• The **ICC** is the global governing body for cricket, founded as the Imperial Cricket Conference in **1909**.
 
• It is headquartered in **Dubai, United Arab Emirates**, and is responsible for organizing major global tournaments like the **World Test Championship (WTC)** and the **ODI World Cup**.
 
 
 
• **Virat Kohli:**
 
 
• While a legend in Test cricket, **Virat Kohli** was recently honored as the **ICC Men’s ODI Cricketer of the Year 2023** following his record-breaking **765 runs** in the **2023 ODI World Cup**.
 
 
 
• **Ravichandran Ashwin:**
 
 
• The veteran off-spinner reached the historic milestone of **500 Test wickets** in **February 2024** during the **Rajkot Test** against **England**, becoming only the second Indian to do so after **Anil Kumble**.
 
 
 
• **ICC Men's Test Cricketer of the Year Award:**
 
 
• This prestigious award was introduced in **2004**. Past winners include greats like **Dale Steyn**, **Sachin Tendulkar**, and **Ricky Ponting**.
 
• The award considers players' performances in **Test matches** over a **12-month period**, evaluating wickets, runs, and match-winning contributions.
 
 
 
• **Rohit Sharma:**
 
 
• The current **Indian Captain** who led the team to the final of the **ICC World Test Championship 2021-23** and the **ICC Men's Cricket World Cup 2023**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Jasprit Bumrah** is often referred to as a "generational talent" due to his unique bowling action and high-speed accuracy.
 
• In **2024**, he became the fastest Indian pacer to reach **150 Test wickets**, achieving the feat in just **34 matches**.
 
• The **ICC Test Rankings** are updated weekly, but the **ICC Annual Awards** provide a cumulative recognition of a player's excellence over the entire calendar year or season.

questions.question: The National Tourism Day was celebrated in India on which date in 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**25 January 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Tourism Day** in **India** is celebrated every year on **25 January** to raise awareness about the importance of tourism for the country's **economy** and **social development**.
 
• In the year **2025**, the day was celebrated on its traditional date of **25 January**, which fell on a **Saturday**.
 
• The primary objective of this day is to highlight the **cultural heritage**, **natural beauty**, and **diversity** of India to both domestic and international tourists.
 
• The **Ministry of Tourism**, Government of India, acts as the nodal agency for organizing various events, seminars, and cultural programs across different states to mark this occasion.
 
• The celebration emphasizes **Sustainable Tourism** and encourages citizens to explore the vast landscapes of the nation, from the **Himalayas** to the backwaters of **Kerala**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **World Tourism Day**: Unlike the national celebration, **World Tourism Day** is observed globally on **27 September** every year under the leadership of the **United Nations World Tourism Organization (UNWTO)**.
 
• **Economic Significance**: The tourism sector is a vital component of India’s **Service Sector**, contributing significantly to the **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)** and serving as a major source of **Foreign Exchange Earnings**.
 
• **Government Initiatives**: Schemes like **Swadesh Darshan** and **PRASHAD** (Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Augmentation Drive) have been launched to develop theme-based tourist circuits and rejuvenate pilgrimage sites.
 
• **Dekho Apna Desh**: This is an initiative by the **Ministry of Tourism** to promote domestic travel among Indians, urging them to visit at least **15 tourist destinations** within India by the year **2022** (and continued as a recurring theme).
 
• **Employment**: The tourism industry is one of the largest employers in India, providing livelihoods to millions of people in **hospitality**, **transportation**, **guiding**, and **handicrafts** sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Date History**: While **25 January** is dedicated to **National Tourism Day**, the same date is also observed as **National Voters' Day** in India to mark the foundation day of the **Election Commission of India** (established in **1950**).
 
• **Incredible India**: The **Incredible India** campaign is the international marketing initiative by the **Government of India** to promote tourism in the country to a global audience.
 
• **Diverse Tourism Products**: India offers a wide range of tourism products including **Medical Tourism**, **Eco-Tourism**, **Adventure Tourism**, and **Religious Tourism**, which are highlighted during the celebrations.
 
• **Statistical Data**: In recent years, India has seen a steady rise in the **Foreign Tourist Arrivals (FTAs)**, and the government aims to position India as a top global destination by **2030** through policy reforms and infrastructure development.

questions.question: In the 2025 Uttarakhand flash flood that occurred on 5 August 2025, which Himalayan village on the route to Gangotri Dham was devastated by a torrent of water, mud and debris?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Dharali in Uttarkashi district, Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dharali village**, located in the **Uttarkashi district** of **Uttarakhand**, witnessed a devastating flash flood on **5 August 2025**. The event was triggered by intense **cloudbursts** in the higher reaches of the **Himalayas**, causing the **Kheer Ganga** rivulet to overflow with immense force.
 
• The village is a significant transit point situated on the **Gangotri National Highway (NH-34)**, approximately **20 kilometers** before the **Gangotri Dham**. It is famous for its **apple orchards** and its proximity to the **Bhagirathi River**.
 
• The **2025 flash flood** caused a massive torrent of **water, mud, and debris** to sweep through the settlement, leading to the burial of several houses and the blockage of the **National Highway**. This disaster disrupted the **Char Dham Yatra**, leaving hundreds of pilgrims stranded.
 
• Historically, **Dharali** and surrounding areas like **Harsil** have been vulnerable to such ecological disturbances due to their **geographical location** in the **High Himalayan zone**, where steep slopes and loose soil contribute to rapid **debris flows** during monsoon seasons.
 
• **Joshimath** is located in the **Chamoli district** and is primarily known for **land subsidence** issues rather than being on the direct route to **Gangotri Dham**. ***Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.***
 
• **Balta** is a village in the **Almora district**, which is part of the **Kumaon division**, whereas the flood occurred in the **Garhwal division**. ***Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.***
 
• **Rudraprayag** is a district headquarters at the confluence of the **Alaknanda** and **Mandakini** rivers, serving as the gateway to **Kedarnath**, not the specific village devastated on the **Gangotri** route in this context. ***Hence, statement 4 is incorrect.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Uttarkashi District:** Established on **24 February 1960**, it is one of the northernmost districts of **India**, sharing an international border with **Tibet (China)**. It houses the origins of the **Ganga (at Gangotri)** and **Yamuna (at Yamunotri)** rivers.
 
• **Gangotri Dham:** One of the four sites in the **Chota Char Dham** pilgrimage. The temple is dedicated to **Goddess Ganga** and is located at an elevation of **3,100 meters**. The region is ecologically sensitive and falls under the **Gangotri National Park** administration.
 
• **Cloudburst Dynamics:** A **cloudburst** is an extreme amount of precipitation in a short period (usually exceeding **100 mm per hour**). In the **Himalayas**, these are frequent during the **monsoon months** (**July to September**) due to the orographic lifting of moisture-laden winds.
 
• **Harsil Valley:** Located very close to **Dharali**, **Harsil** is known as the "**Mini Switzerland of India**." It sits at an altitude of **2,620 meters** and is inhabited by the **Bhotia tribe**. The area is critical for **border security** and **tourism**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Disaster Management:** Following the **2025 flood**, the **State Disaster Response Force (SDRF)** and **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF)** conducted extensive operations. Under the **Disaster Management Act, 2005**, the district administration is empowered to evacuate vulnerable zones.
 
• **Geological Vulnerability:** The **Main Central Thrust (MCT)** passes through the **Uttarkashi** region, making it seismically active (Zone V) and prone to **landslides**. The **1991 Uttarkashi earthquake** (magnitude **6.8**) remains one of the most significant tectonic events in this area.
 
• **National Highway 34:** This highway connects **Rishikesh** to **Gangotri**. Constant maintenance is required due to the fragile **shale and schist** rock formations that frequently collapse during heavy rains.
 
• **Ecological Impact:** The accumulation of **debris** in the **Bhagirathi River** can lead to the formation of temporary **artificial lakes**, which pose a downstream threat of **Glacial Lake Outburst Floods (GLOF)** or flash floods if the blockages burst suddenly.
